weather.typical: Cool, wet maritime Olympic climate that can deteriorate quickly even in the July-September window
weather.probability: Rain shadow location (east side of the Olympics, per Jefferson County terrain) means somewhat drier than the west-side Olympics, but fast-moving Pacific frontal systems can still bring sudden rain/wind even in summer

seasonal_hazards.exposure: Serious fall consequences on the exposed, unroped summit block; compounded by rotten, tilted pillow-basalt rock that pulls loose readily (a 2022 fatality occurred here tied to route-finding errors onto cliffy ground)

avalanche.zone: N/A - non-glaciated summer route; nearest NWAC coverage (Olympics zone) is oriented toward winter/spring forecasting and does not specifically model this route's approach gullies

seasonal_hazards.crevasses: N/A - no glacier travel on the standard Deception Creek/Royal Basin route itself; this is steep snow gullies and rock, not glacier crossing
